Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract and for your feedback. I appreciate you bringing these points to my attention.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for a net-30 structure. Let’s discuss this further to see if we can reach a middle ground that works for both parties. As for the non-compete clause, I agree that we should review it to ensure it is equitable and reasonable. I am happy to schedule a brief call later this week to discuss both of these adjustments in detail.

Please let me know what days and times work best for you.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
